# Introduction

The `eulob` package provides access to EU-LOB, a
catalogue of lobbying organizations registered in
national European registers and the EU Transparency Register.

The bundled catalogue can be queried without an internet connection.

# Load the package

```{r}
library(eulob)
```

# Explore the available registers

```{r}
eulob_countries()
eulob_registers()
```

The code `UE` identifies the EU Transparency Register.
It is not an ISO country code.

# Explore the Spanish register

```{r}
eulob_registers(country = "ES")
head(eulob_lobbies(country = "ES"))
```

# Search organization names

Searches use literal, case-insensitive substring matching.

```{r}
eulob_search("association", limit = 5)
eulob_search("universidad", country = "UE", limit = 5)
```

# Understanding identifiers

Each record connects an organization name to an identifier
in an official lobbying register.

The `name_id` identifies a normalized name, whereas
`lobby_id` is specific to the source register.

Different register entries may share the same name.
The catalogue does not perform global entity resolution.

# Export results

```{r, eval=FALSE}
spanish <- eulob_lobbies(country = "ES")
write.csv(spanish, "spanish_lobbies.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Package information

```{r}
eulob_info()
eulob_version()
```
